description.zh: 数据源ID。您可调用接口[ListParserDataSource](~~432676~~)，查询数据源列表，获取**DataSourceId**。
description.en: The DataSource ID. You can call the [ListParserDataSource](~~432676~~) API to query the data source list and obtain the **DataSourceId**.

description.zh: 数据源Topic的ID。您可调用接口[ListDataSourceItem](~~421072~~)，查询指定数据源下的Topic列表，获取**DataSourceItemId**。
description.en: The ID of the data source topic. You can call the [ListDataSourceItem](~~421072~~) API to query the list of topics under a specified data source and obtain the **DataSourceItemId**.

description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无**实例概览**页面或ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID. You can view the current instance **ID** on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID exists, you must specify it; otherwise, the invocation fails.
- If the **Instance Overview** page or the ID does not exist, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Instance Overview](~~356505~~).

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为10。

> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## QPS limit

The maximum queries per second (QPS) for this API is 10 for each Alibaba Cloud account.

> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
